The [[Horde of Darkness (NPC)|Horde of Darkness]] is an elite force in the ranks of the [[Margonite]]s. These [[demon]]s are the chosen of [[Abaddon]] and fought directly beside him against the other gods during the assault on the [[Gates of Heaven]]. These Margonites were gifted with immunity to all damage; only the [[Junundu Siege]] can circumvent this power.

== Locations ==
* [[The Desolation]]
** {{NPC location|The Alkali Pan}} (before completing [[Horde of Darkness]])

* [[Margonite Armor]]
* [[Margonite Mask]]
* [[Margonite Robes]]
* [[Margonite Tunic]]

== Notes ==
* The [[health degeneration]] from [[Burning Breath]] still affects them, making it possible to kill them without [[Junundu Siege]].
* The Horde of Darkness have significantly higher maximum [[health]] than most other creatures of the same level, and have constant [[health regeneration]].

== Trivia ==
* Despite being warriors, they wield [[spear]]s and use them for [[ranged attack]]s. The reason for this is that they use the same model as [[Margonite Ascendant]]s.
